spanish: Porque alma de la carne en la sangre ella, y yo la di a ustedes sobre el altar para expiar sobre sus almas, porque la sangre ella en el alma expiará.

findings.issue: Object suffix is 3ms; la is feminine, so the given participant is no longer the masculine token and can be read as the feminine soul.
Pronoun is 3ms; ella is feminine and matches the earlier 3fs pronoun instead.

notes: Ustedes for the 2mp suffixes is licensed; the other tokens match in number, stem, and lexicon.
